label: For "Healthcare Contract-Based Price Variance Detection": Find differences between contracted and invoiced or paid prices after accounting for units, tiers, rebates, freight, taxes and amendments, and quantify the recoverable amount for finance to validate. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Treating all variance as recoverable.
